instruction: Use the OPTIMADE API to query structures containing at least one transition metal (Fe, Co, or Ni) with a computed band gap greater than 1.0 eV (elements HAS ANY "Fe","Co","Ni" AND band_gap > 1.0). Find the structure with the highest band gap value and save its Material ID to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\optimade\opt_task_9.txt'.
_comments: OPTIMADE API task, no file input required
